verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a single free business account (Jeeves Cash) that holds and receives balances in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD, with instant conversion between them, so the core story is directly delivered. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing pages, and balance holding beyond four currencies (40+ currencies are cited only for payouts).

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account

citations.quote: Optimize foreign exchange costs by managing and receiving cash in USD, EUR, GBP, & CAD - all through one free business account.
Multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield, real-time FX conversion, and multi-currency balance storage.
Manage cash in multiple currencies, issue cards, pay bills, and earn up to 5% annually\* all from one digital account.
Exchange between CAD, EUR, GBP,  & USD instantly
Convert funds between your Jeeves Cash accounts when exchange rates are favourable.
